name: The Glowing Mask
content:
**Item #:** COR-003

**Object Class:** Safe

**Special Containment Procedures:** COR-003 must be contained in a titanium container at site 3, 5mm thick. It must be then surrounded by a 5 x 5 foot tub of water, and all testings must be done 10 feet away from the box.

**Description:** COR-003 is an ancient egyptian mask worn by the pharaoh. It has two exaggerated ears, and a long neck.

name: The Obsidian Compass
content:
**Item #:** COR-001

**Object Class:** Safe

**Special Containment Procedures:** COR-001 is to be kept in a standard secure containment locker at Site-19. Testing requires Level 3 authorization.

**Description:** COR-001 is a hand-carved compass composed of high-purity obsidian and brass. Instead of pointing toward magnetic north, the needle consistently rotates to indicate the nearest point of temporal anomaly or spatial distortion within a [REDACTED] kilometer radius.

name: Amnestic Phonograph
content:
**Item #:** COR-449

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures:** Stored in an acoustic dampening vault. No personnel are permitted within 5 meters while the cylinder is mounted.

**Description:** COR-449 is a 19th-century brass horn phonograph. When any wax cylinder is played on COR-449, listeners within hearing range immediately experience complete retrograde amnesia spanning the preceding [REDACTED] hours.
